archetypes.name: dyn-panel-env
archetypes.rationale: Panel telemetry depends on env propagation across several dispatcher layers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed panel dispatch paths and launchers for missing or stale LARCH_PANEL_* environment values. Focus on whether aggregator, voter, specialist, and implementer rows route to the intended round-scoped TSV without instrumenting non-panel callers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
